items.title: AI Benchmarking
items.description: Reproducible AI benchmarks with verifiable model performance tracking. Compare AI models head-to-head with complete transparency and trust.

items.title: 1 vs 1 AI Training
items.description: Master your skills through focused training sessions against intelligent AI opponents. Learn strategies, refine tactics, and become an expert.

items.title: Track Your Progress
items.description: Watch your skills evolve with comprehensive analytics. Detailed statistics, performance trends, and personalized insights guide your journey.

items.title: Global Leaderboards
items.description: Compete with players worldwide. On-chain leaderboard snapshots ensure fair rankings you can trust and verify.

items.title: Everything On-Chain
items.description: Complete transparency through Solana blockchain. Every match, score, and achievement is permanently recorded and verifiable.

items.title: Play Your Way
items.description: Choose your experience - play completely free or enter money matches. Same great games, your choice of stakes.

items.title: Solana Powered
items.description: Built on Solana for speed and efficiency. Verifiable match records with Merkle batching keep costs low and trust high.

items.title: True Multiplayer
items.description: Robust multiplayer framework supporting turn-based games. Seamless matchmaking, lifecycle management, and dynamic player capacity.

items.title: Wallet Freedom
items.description: Connect with Solana or Ethereum wallets. Optional self-custody gives you full control, or use our custodial solution.

items.title: Intelligent AI
items.description: Face off against AI opponents powered by advanced machine learning. Each AI has unique strategies and personalities.

items.title: Rewarding Economy
items.description: Earn Game Payment (GP) and AI Credit (AC) tokens. Daily rewards, subscriptions, and achievements fuel your progression.

items.title: Provably Fair
items.description: Every match is verifiable. On-chain anchors combined with off-chain storage provide complete transparency and trust.

items.title: Fair Play Guaranteed
items.description: On-chain dispute resolution ensures integrity. Automated systems and transparent processes protect every player.

items.title: Play Anywhere
items.description: Seamless experience across Web, iOS, and Android. Your progress syncs everywhere, play on any device.
